variant.title: 159 Sudoku
variant.description: In each row, cells 1, 5, and 9 contain column numbers; the cells they point to must contain 1, 5, and 9 respectively.
rule_guide.title: 159 Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Check three locator cells in each row. If cell 1 contains N, cell N in that row must contain 1. If cell 5 contains N, cell N must contain 5; if cell 9 contains N, cell N must contain 9.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, if the first cell of a row contains 4, count to the fourth cell from the left; it must contain 1. If the fifth cell contains 7, the seventh cell must contain 5.
